personal.preferred_title: Senior Python Backend / Data Engineer | APIs, AWS, Databases & Production Reliability

summary: Senior backend/data engineering professional with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience across Python, SQL, APIs and integrations, object-oriented design, distributed enterprise systems, AWS cloud workflows, relational databases, production support, performance tuning, reliability, documentation, mentoring, and AI/ML data workflow exposure. Strong background building and supporting reliable Python-driven systems, integrating internal platforms, validating production outputs, troubleshooting complex incidents, and collaborating with application, infrastructure, analytics, and business teams. Best aligned to backend/data engineering roles requiring Python, API integration, databases, cloud-native practices, service reliability, production ownership, code-quality discipline, and collaboration with data science or AI/ML teams; Java/.NET and pure application-service ownership are positioned carefully as transferable or earlier-career experience rather than overstated recent ownership.
